notes: Large-source unit checked: אֲשֶׁר … עָלָיו → *whereon* is indivisible under rule 22 — the suffix resumes the antecedent and the one word carries the relation and the resumption alike; contiguity is not the condition (rule 35).

*even upon Egypt* stands before a nominal renaming what precedes, with no marker on the phrase and no conjunction beside the preposition, so the *even* is `added` (rule 16); the supplied *if* answers to no morpheme in that clause (rule 55), and the ethical dative לְּךָ and its suffix are each `unrepresented` (rule 40).
